name: propertyease-mcp-registry
description: Model Context Protocol tool registry for the PropertyEase AI-OS. Declares external tools the LLM can invoke. Engine-independent: any MCP-compliant client can read this.

_meta.notes: When you add a tool here, document it. When you remove a tool, write a memory note explaining why.

servers.name: github
servers.description: GitHub API — repos, PRs, issues, actions, code search

servers.name: filesystem
servers.description: Local filesystem access — the AI-OS's primary workspace. Already provided by the host, declared here for documentation.
servers._note: This is provided by the host runtime (Claude Code, Cursor, etc). Declared here so every agent knows the canonical file operations.

servers.name: supabase
servers.description: Supabase project — Postgres queries, auth checks, storage. Read-only at the MCP layer; mutations go through API routes.
servers._warning: Mutations through MCP are FORBIDDEN. All writes go through API routes (contracts/api-envelope.md). Use execute_sql only for SELECT.

servers.name: vercel
servers.description: Vercel deploys, env vars, function logs, project config

servers.name: openai
servers.description: OpenAI API — used by PropertyEase Copilot, ad-copy, and lead-scoring. Configured via the app, not directly by agents.

transport._note: Not exposed as an MCP tool. Agents call this via API routes in propertyease/src/app/api/ai/**, not directly.

servers._policy: Direct LLM calls from agents are forbidden. All AI features go through contracts/prompts/ + the API layer. This keeps prompt versioning and eval coverage centralized.

servers.name: linear
servers.description: Linear — issue tracking and sprint planning

policies.secret_handling: All tokens come from environment variables. NEVER hard-code tokens in this file. The ${VAR} syntax is resolved by the host at runtime.
policies.read_only_by_default: Mutations (create, update, delete) require explicit agent authorization per the AGENTS.md contract. When in doubt, the agent is read-only.
policies.versioning: Bump this file's version when adding/removing a server. Add a memory note explaining the change.
policies.engine_independence: This file uses the standard MCP spec. Any MCP-compliant client can parse it. No Claude-specific, GPT-specific, or proxy-specific fields.
